name: Patient Maw
description: Hang a maw of soul force in open air that waits unhurried and closes on whatever first stirs it.

name: Binding Skein
description: Wind a skein of soul force round a caught soul that tightens with each breath it spends resisting.

name: Deepening Taint
description: Leave a taint of soul force that deepens in a caught soul for as long as it stays near the trap.

name: Seamless Veil
description: Draw a seamless veil of soul force about the self that no soul probe finds a way through.

name: Gaoler's Silence
description: Seal every technique of a caught soul under a stillness of soul force that nothing inside can break.

name: Immured Will
description: Wall a target's will inside soul force until it can no longer reach its own strength.

name: Bottomless Gaol
description: Open a cage of soul force with no floor that holds every soul falling into it.

name: Thorn Eternal
description: Drive a thorn of soul force into a soul and leave it lodged where no guard can reach.

name: Apex Latch
description: Gather the full reach of the soul into one latch that closes on a single soul and cannot be forced.

name: Closing Aeon
description: Close a vast lattice of soul force on all souls in range and hold it shut for a long span.

name: Unmaking Gaol
description: Cast a cage of soul force at the destructive ceiling of its tier that crushes every soul inside.

name: Foreclosed Escape
description: Close the snare on the place where a soul stood a breath ago so a soul that already slipped away is bound there.
